cues.en: One of the challenges of Mcinturff research is that llms have no representation of isolated words,
cues.zh: 機制可解釋性研究的一項挑戰，是 LLM 沒有孤立單字的表徵，

cues.en: because they have never been trained on isolated words.
cues.zh: 因為從未以孤立單字訓練。

cues.en: They are pre-trained on really, really long sequences of text.
cues.zh: 預訓練使用的是非常、非常長的文字序列。

cues.en: Of course, that's not a problem.

cues.en: But it is really a challenge for Mcinturff research, in particular with reproducibility, because findings
cues.zh: 但對機制可解釋性研究，確實是挑戰，尤其可重現性，因為

cues.en: that might work for certain contexts might not work for other contexts.
